Auditor's mitigation note: Explicitly permitted by packet step S5; fails closed with McpError(INTERNAL_ERROR) if _request_id is missing or non-int, and is pinned by test_m1_followup_sdk_request_id_contract_fails_closed_if_missing.

Auditor risk (low), src/dopemux/mcp/launcher.py lines 440-457: Synchronous termination loop in _live_build_pid can block up to 4.0s (2.0s SIGTERM wait + 2.0s SIGKILL wait) when reaping an expired build that ignores SIGTERM.
